A reference class for database screening.

Report-class.Rd

This is a class for conducting non-target screening data evaluation based on database searching by m/z, retention time and MS2 spectral comparison. View the vignette "Database screening with Report in ntsworkflow" for a step-by-step guide on how to use this function.

Details

Initialize a Report by calling Report$new() this starts a new Report with the default settings (see settings field, below). Settings can be changed by calling the changeSettings method. Load files by calling the addRawFiles method and process files with the process_all method. After processing the Report can be saved for viewing in the visuallization tool (susS app).

Fields

rawFiles

A character vector with file paths in the order in which they are to be displayed.

settings

A list with settings for all processing steps. The settings list contains the following fields and defaults: list(db_path = NULL, rttolm = 1, mztolu = 0.05, mztolu_fine = 0.005, chromatography = "bfg_nts_rp1", pol = "pos", ce_s = 30:40, ces_s = 0:15, instr = "LC-ESI-QTOF TripleTOF 5600 SCIEX", ceunit = c("V", "eV"), comparison = "dot_product", threshold = 400, rt_res = 1.5, EIC_extraction = 0.05, baseline_noise_MS1 = 0.5, sn = 3, rtoffset = 0, IS_rtoffset = 0, ISrttolm = 1, blank_int_factor = 3, rtTolReinteg = 1, mzTolReinteg = 0.005, ndp_m = 0.4, ndp_n = 1, mztolu_ms2 = 0.015, area_threshold = 1, height_threshold = 1, use_int_threshold = "area". db_path: path to sqlite spectral-database (SDB). rttolm: retention time tolerance for the suspect search. mztolu: m/z tolerance for the spectrum extraction (MS2 precursor mass). mztolu_fine: m/z tolerance for precursor mass in MS1. chromatography Is the chromatographic method allowed from the SDB. pol: polarity. ce_s: allowed collision energies from SDB. ces_s: allowed collision energy spreads from SDB. instr: allowed instruments from SDB. ceunit: allowed collision energy unit from SDB. comparison: algorithm to use for spectral comparison, currently only the default is allowed. threshold: score of spectral comparison under which results are rejected automatically, 1000=perfect match. rt_res: Resolution of chrom. peaks (see ms2_search) in min. Peaks with RT difference > rt_res are considered to be from different substances. EIC_extraction: Extraction width to produce EIC, affects integration. baseline_noise_MS1: Signals under this intensity are ignored and also not included in the saved spectra. sn: signal-to-noise ratio limit for peak integration. rtoffset: Retention time offset between samples and database. ISrttolm: RT tolerance for IS peak finding and integration. blank_int_factor: Intensity factor to remove compounds found in blank. Peak in sample must be within blank_int_factor: * intensity in blank. rtTolReinteg: is the retention time tolerance for reintegration. mzTolReinteg: is the m/z tolerance for reintegration. ndp_m: Peak intensity weighting factor for dot-product, ndp_n: m/z weighting factor for dot-product, mztolu_ms2: m/z tolerance for dot-product fragment mass binning, area_threshold: Peak area intensity threshold. height_threshold: Peak height intensity threshold. use_int_threshold: can be either "area", "height", or "none" peaksPerPeak: mustFindChromPeak: default FALSE, if TRUE, peaks without area are deleted

rawFilesCompl

data.frame with processed files and date of processing.

peakList

data.frame with all suspect search results.

currentPeakID

numeric to keep track of peakIDs, do not change.

MS1

data.frame holding all MS1 spectra.

EIC

data.frame holding all chromatograms.

MS2

data.frame holding all MS2 spectra.

IS

data.frame with list of IS to process, this has to be imported from a csv file (comma sep) using this method addIS(). The csv file should have the columns name, formula, rt, adduct. Where formula is in the form e.g. for CBZ: C14 13CH12N 15NO, and adduct is in the form [M+H]+ or [M]+.

ISresults

data.frame with results of IS processings.

falsePos

data.frame recording which false positives should be deleted in which files

Methods

addIS(dialog = TRUE, fileName = NULL)

Include a list of internal standards in the report. Dialog indicates use of interactive file choosing dialog. The file should be a csv with 4 columns: 'name', 'formula', 'rt', 'adduct'.

addRawFiles(dialog = TRUE, file_list = NULL)

Add raw files, (mzML or mzXML) Dialog indicates use of interactive file choosing dialog. Does not load files to RAM, only marks file path.

addRawFilesDir(dialog = TRUE, dir_path = NULL)

Add all raw files in the chosen directory

changeSettings(parameter, value)

Change any setting by name and then value. See settings field for more details.

cleanDuplicateCol()

Check the peaklist for duplicates, if peaks previously indicated as duplicates are no longer so then set duplicate column back to NA

cleanPeakLetterCol()

Check the peaklist for multiple peaks from one compound, if any B, C etc. peaks no longer have an A peak, these are renamed to start with A

clearAndSave(dialog = TRUE, nameReport = NULL, clearData = TRUE)

Clear data (optionally) from RAM and save report as .report file in the current working directory. Use nameReport to give a different location and different name as in *.clearAndSave(F, 'D:/exampleFolder/example'). Note: The folder must exist beforehand. To read the file again, use the function ntsworkflow::loadReport

clearData(indices = NULL)

Remove data from RAM to clear memory, use indices of raw files

deleteBackground(indicesData, indicesBlank, includeIS = FALSE)

Delete background signals based on intensity. Use indices to indicate blanks and samples. If there is more than one blank then these will be combined. If IS should also be deleted use includeIS. Removal is based on intensity ratio, see settings.

deleteFP(substanceName, indices = 0)

Delete all occurances of a compound given by name. Only one compound can be given. Name must match exactly. Compound is added to list of falsePos (see fields). If indices = 0, then compound is always deleted, in all samples and also in future processed samples. Otherwise it is only deleted in the specified samples (by index).

getPeak(rawLinki, comp_mzi, comp_rti, minIndi, maxIndi, width, mztoli, rttoli)

Internal function to integrate peaks during processing

loadData(all = FALSE, indices = NULL)

Load files that still need to be processed into RAM for fast access, if all = TRUE then all files are loaded regardless, if indices is an integer vector, only these samps will be loaded

loadSettings()

Load previously settings file from current working directory. This will fail if there is more than one file present in the directory.

moveRawFile(index, direction)

Move a raw file in direction 'up' or 'down'

plotEIC(ID)

Plot a particular EIC using the ID from the peak list table

plotMS1(ID)

Plot a MS1 spectrum using the ID from the peak list table. Includes comparison to calculated isotopic pattern.

plotMS2(ID)

Plot an MS2 spectrum using the ID from the peak list table. Includes comparison to database spectrum used to make the identification.

process_all(comp_names = NULL, alsoDeleteFP = TRUE)

Process all currently unprocessed files in the report object. Previously recorded false positives (without specified sample) are deleted by default.

reIntegrate(indices)

Reintegrate peak areas for all found compounds based only on m/z and rt. No MS2 comparison will be performed. The m/z and rt are taken as an average of those found in the peak list.

reduceSizeEic()

Will average out data points outside of the peak to reduce size of the EIC table

remRawFiles(indices)

Delete files based on their indices

reprocess(indices = NULL, comp_names = NULL, alsoDeleteFP = TRUE)

Reprocess files or specific compounds, will delete all previous information. As with process_all, previous FP will be deleted by default

saveSettings(path = getwd())

Save settings to a json file. Name of file is generated from current time.

view()

View results using shiny.
